vectors.name: code
vectors.why: The host holding the mailbox, the secret, and the first half of the hash of the ID of the owner who made it, each in lower-case base32, 26 characters.

vectors.name: code_with_spaces_around_it
vectors.why: A chat window may add whitespace around what's pasted.

vectors.name: code_at_a_port
vectors.why: A host is written as in an address.

vectors.name: code_in_capitals
vectors.why: A code has one spelling.

vectors.name: code_without_its_prefix
vectors.why: It says what it is.

vectors.name: code_with_a_short_secret
vectors.why: The secret is 128 bits, 26 characters.

vectors.name: code_with_a_long_secret
vectors.why: And no more.

vectors.name: code_with_padding
vectors.why: Base32 without padding.

vectors.name: code_with_leftover_bits_set
vectors.why: The last character's 2 spare bits are zero, so one secret has one spelling.

vectors.name: code_naming_a_host_in_capitals
vectors.why: A host has one spelling, as in an address.

vectors.name: code_naming_no_owner
vectors.why: A code names the owner who made it, so whoever opens its mailbox later can't be taken for them.

vectors.name: code_with_a_short_owner
vectors.why: The owner part is 16 bytes, 26 characters.

vectors.name: code_with_owner_leftover_bits_set
vectors.why: And has one spelling too.

vectors.name: code_with_another_part
vectors.why: Three parts after the prefix, no more.

vectors.name: pairing
vectors.why: An owner's session opens a mailbox at its host for 15 minutes at most, signed by the session's key.

vectors.name: pairing_by_a_passkey
vectors.why: An owner whose key is a passkey signs the session, and the session's key the pairing, with no touch of its own.

vectors.name: pairing_over
vectors.why: A mailbox closes at its end.

vectors.name: pairing_dated_ahead
vectors.why: It can't start later than the owner's clock allows.

vectors.name: pairing_for_more_than_15_minutes
vectors.why: A code lasts 15 minutes at most.

vectors.name: pairing_outlasting_its_session
vectors.why: A session can't keep a mailbox open in its owner's name past its own end.

vectors.name: pairing_for_another_host
vectors.why: A pairing opens a mailbox at the host it names, even under a session good at the host reading it.

vectors.name: pairing_under_a_session_for_another_host
vectors.why: A session opens mailboxes only at the host it names.

vectors.name: pairing_naming_another_owner
vectors.why: It names the owner whose session's key signed it.

vectors.name: pairing_signed_by_another_key
vectors.why: Only the session's own key opens one under it.

vectors.name: pairing_signed_by_the_owners_own_key
vectors.why: A pairing is the session key's to sign. The owner's key signs the session.

vectors.name: pairing_signed_by_a_passkey
vectors.why: A passkey signs only what an owner's key signs, and a pairing isn't that.

vectors.name: pairing_under_another_owners_session
vectors.why: Another owner's session, read as this owner's, is checked under this owner's key.

vectors.name: pairing_by_a_stand_in
vectors.why: A stand-in's key is on an agent's machine, so it starts no session and pairs nothing.

vectors.name: pairing_by_a_guest
vectors.why: A guest's key lasts one request and has no agents. Only a link reads a guest's ID, so one handed over as an owner's isn't read.

vectors.name: pairing_with_a_proof_in_capitals
vectors.why: A proof is lowercase hex.

vectors.name: pairing_in_another_field_order
vectors.why: One encoding.

vectors.name: opener
vectors.why: The agent checks who opened the mailbox its code names: the owner the code names, by a proof only the code's secret makes, under that owner's session.

vectors.name: opener_by_a_passkey
vectors.why: A code made by an owner whose key is a passkey names their ID the same way.

vectors.name: opener_proven_with_another_secret
vectors.why: A host holding a session can't make the proof without the code's secret.

vectors.name: opener_naming_an_owner_the_code_doesnt
vectors.why: Anyone with the code can make the proof for an owner of their own, and open its mailbox under their own session once the owner's has closed. The code names its maker, so the agent takes nobody else.

vectors.name: opener_of_another_mailbox
vectors.why: The pairing has to be for the mailbox the code names.

vectors.name: opener_whose_session_isnt_the_owners
vectors.why: A host can't open a mailbox in an owner's name with a session key of its own.

vectors.name: answer
vectors.why: An agent's ID, address and delegate key, under a MAC by the code's secret.

vectors.name: answer_under_another_secret
vectors.why: Only an agent given the code can answer it, so a host can't answer in an agent's place.

vectors.name: answer_with_its_address_changed
vectors.why: The MAC covers the address the page shows.

vectors.name: answer_with_its_delegate_changed
vectors.why: And the delegate key the owner signs a delegation to.

vectors.name: answer_with_its_id_changed
vectors.why: And the ID.

vectors.name: answer_with_a_mac_in_capitals
vectors.why: A MAC is lowercase hex.

vectors.name: answer_with_an_address_in_another_spelling
vectors.why: An address has one spelling.

vectors.name: answer_from_an_agent_whose_key_is_a_passkey
vectors.why: Only an owner's key can be a passkey.
